items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 08 May 2026 at 8:25am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds in places later.


##Synopsis##

Low to the northwest of Scotland, moving to the Norwegian Sea.


##Wind##

Variable 1 to 3 in the east this morning, north or northeast 2 to 4 in the west. Becoming a mainly northerly 3 or 4 this afternoon, increasing 5 in the west of the area this evening, then more generally 4 or 5 overnight, but occasionally 6 in the west and 3 in the southeast.


##State of Sea##

Mostly slight, occasionally moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Fair with isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in the west. Veering northeast 5 or 6 Saturday afternoon, decreasing 4 or 5 overnight into Sunday.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair with isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
